## Task
An anonymous black-box function of 10 continuous inputs in [0, 1]; lower is better.

## Inputs
| parameter | type | domain | scale |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x_d01` | real | [0, 1] | linear |
| `x_643` | real | [0, 1] | linear |
| `x_156` | real | [0, 1] | linear |
| `x_921` | real | [0, 1] | linear |
| `x_52f` | real | [0, 1] | linear |
| `x_b52` | real | [0, 1] | linear |
| `x_e70` | real | [0, 1] | linear |
| `x_2a0` | real | [0, 1] | linear |
| `x_437` | real | [0, 1] | linear |
| `x_c93` | real | [0, 1] | linear |

## Outputs
- `y`: objective; minimize (lower is better).

## Noise
Observations are noiseless: repeated evaluations of the same input return the same value.
